description: This file contains functions and types related to managing and migrating bundled plugin load paths in an OpenClaw configuration, including path normalization, legacy path building, scanning for path migrations, generating warnings, and repairing paths.

classes.name: BundledPluginLoadPathHit
classes.description: Type representing a hit/match in bundled plugin load path migration, including plugin ID, from and to paths, and label.

methods.name: resolveBundledWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory for bundled plugins based on the configuration.

methods.name: normalizeBundledLookupPath
methods.description: Normalizes a given path by removing trailing separators.

methods.name: buildLegacyBundledPath
methods.description: Constructs a legacy bundled plugin path from a local path.

methods.name: scanBundledPluginLoadPathMigrations
methods.description: Scans configuration for bundled plugin load path migrations, returning matches.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginLoadPathWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages for detected path mismatches.

methods.name: maybeRepairBundledPluginLoadPaths
methods.description: Attempts to fix path mismatches in the configuration, returning updated config and change logs.
